name: oorexx_api_client_socket_provider_adapter
role: API Client byte-carrier acquisition through SocketProvider with dynamic Socket Intention route resolution and optional deployment admission

authority.socket_provider: native transport acquisition and selected SocketAddress
authority.adapter: carrier shape, readiness bridge and optional post-selection admission seam
authority.socket_intention: fresh per-request carrier offer discovery and selection
authority.deployment_policy: optional exact selected-route evidence admission; no transport semantics are hard-coded

xtp.policy_note: deployment may require lower-route attestation/protection evidence through generic SocketAddress metadata without teaching this adapter XTP semantics

dynamic_route_resolution.reason: API Client TLS runs above the selected raw byte carrier
dynamic_route_resolution.postSelectionAdmission: optional ApiSocketRouteAdmissionPolicy; failure is closed before SocketProvider acquisition
